source: Corrochano, Melrose, Bentley, Fryer, Bakalis (2015) J. Food Eng. 150, 106-116. Open access, CC BY 3.0.
what: Espresso-style packed beds of roast and ground coffee, pressure-driven steady flow, 90 C water. Four grind distributions A-D packed to three starting bulk densities.
d32_provenance: Table 1, dry laser diffraction (text table, copied)
k_provenance: Table 2, measured steady-state permeability; rows A-D, columns 360/400/480 kg/m3 (text table, copied)
eps_bed_provenance: Fig. 13 (raster image), consolidated steady-state bed porosity. Marker centres found by pixel search after removing the error-bar line; axes calibrated from the frame lines. Overlay check: corrochano2015_fig13_overlay.png. Reading uncertainty about +-0.003. Error bars (about +-0.03 to +-0.1) were not digitized because the caps overlap between markers. Text states all values lie in 0.12-0.33.
sphericity_provenance: Section 4.1 text: mean of the four distributions' mean sphericity, adopted by the authors
paper_model1_error: Paper's own Kozeny-Carman (constant 180, d = sphericity x d32) error: 31 % for A rising to 521 % for D, always over-predicting (Fig. 14a).
